items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Duffy was with them, with Cleveland Eaton on bass, and they had a constant fight all night at the time.

ctx.x: Yeah, I didn’t care for Sonny Payne. Butch Miles was with him. Actually with Duffy, Wayne and I went down to Florida and did some stuff around Tampa, and we had the band. It was the first night Thad was leading the band, and Duffy was with them, with Cleveland Eaton on bass, and they had a constant fight all night at the time. [Laughs] It was really funny.
